name: Robinhood

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (File:Robinhood Markets logo.png, 3259 px wide)

description: Robinhood runs a mobile-first investing app with 27.0 million funded customers and $322.1 billion of platform assets at 2025-12-31. It earns money three ways: transaction fees (mostly payment for order flow on options and equities, and a markup on crypto trades), interest (margin lending, interest on customer cash, cash sweep and securities lending), and subscriptions (Robinhood Gold, 4.18 million subscribers) plus proxy and other fees. It reports one segment, so profit is only available for the whole company: $1,883M net income in 2025 on $4,473M revenue. Crypto, options and margin make revenue sensitive to trading activity and interest rates.

businessLines.name: Transaction-based revenues
businessLines.how: Earns a fee each time a customer trades: rebates from market makers who execute retail options and equity orders (payment for order flow), a spread on crypto trades, and commissions on event contracts and other products; volume-driven and cyclical.

businessLines.name: Net interest revenues
businessLines.how: Earns interest spread: margin loans to customers, yield on customer cash held at banks (cash sweep) and in segregated accounts, securities lending income and credit card interest, less interest on credit facilities.

businessLines.name: Other revenues
businessLines.how: Gold monthly subscription (recurring, paid in advance; 4.18 million subscribers at 2025-12-31, up 58 percent), proxy service revenue from issuers, and other fees.

brands.name: Robinhood Gold, Robinhood Legend (active-trader platform), Prediction Markets Hub, Robinhood Strategies/wealth management
brands.note: Only Gold revenue is disclosed ($179M, 4.0 percent of revenue)

brands.name: Bitstamp Ltd.
brands.note: Acquired in 2025; global crypto exchange with retail and institutional customers, extends European expansion; revenue not broken out.

brands.name: TradePMR
brands.note: Custodial and portfolio platform for registered investment advisers; acquired (date not read); revenue not broken out.

brands.name: Pending acquisitions at 10-K date: WonderFi, PT Buana Capital Sekuritas, PT Pedagang Aset Kripto
